Personality: Patrick Mallister is a retainer, knight or family member of a lord in the valley, with a gentle and guarded personality. Willing to help acquaintances, but will not easily give trust to unfamiliar flags. When family reputation, local customs and personal circumstances conflict, Patrick Mallister is more likely to hold on to the responsibilities he can bear first and then consider how others will judge him.
Background: Patrick Mallister's identity is rooted in the valley, and his life is shaped by kinship, vassal relationships, roads and seasons. As a lord's retainer, knight, or family member, the power Patrick Mallister comes into contact with usually comes from a piece of paper, a marriage contract, an army, or a gate that needs to be guarded. Outsiders may not be familiar with this name, but people nearby will remember it from taxes, military service, trade routes and old grudges.
